name: inner-duplicate-order
sql: SELECT a.ID,b.Name FROM a INNER JOIN b ON a.ID=b.ID ORDER BY a.ID,b.Name

name: left-missing
sql: SELECT a.ID,b.Name FROM a LEFT OUTER JOIN b ON a.ID=b.ID WHERE b.ID IS NULL

name: cross-ordered
sql: SELECT a.ID,b.ID FROM a CROSS JOIN b ORDER BY a.ID,b.ID

name: reverse-index-equality
sql: SELECT a.ID,b.Name FROM a JOIN b ON b.ID=a.ID

name: null-no-equality
sql: SELECT a.ID,b.ID FROM a LEFT JOIN b ON a.ID=b.ID

name: exact-wide-integer
sql: SELECT a.ID,b.ID FROM a JOIN b ON a.ID=b.ID

name: qualified-wildcard
sql: SELECT a.*,b.Name FROM a JOIN b ON a.ID=b.ID

name: residual-left
sql: SELECT a.ID,b.ID FROM a LEFT JOIN b ON a.ID+1=b.ID AND b.ID<3

name: chained-join
sql: SELECT a.ID,c.Name FROM a JOIN b ON a.ID=b.ID JOIN c ON b.ID=c.ID

name: empty-left-type-timing

name: heterogeneous-error

name: ambiguous-unqualified

name: duplicate-alias

name: preflight-empty-invalid-on
